description: Context engineering MCP server — concept maps for codebases so LLMs stop re-exploring every session.

tool_signatures.name: get_context
tool_signatures.description: Assemble task context: matching decisions with rationale, approval, owner, sources, last review, and freshness, plus related tests, file impact, and any available map entries. Map verification is rechecked against sampled source contents; stale or unknown verification requires a fresh review, and recordedVerdict preserves the historical verdict. Proposals are suggestions; legacy records are unreviewed; accepted decisions are constraints subject to freshness. No initialization or map required. Pass task and optional files. map.status and diagnostics preserve missing or invalid knowledge. Impact covers up to three unique files, expanding directory anchors.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

task.description: The task, bug, or change request in natural language

files.description: Optional file paths already known to be involved (e.g. from a diff or stack trace). Entries containing them are boosted above pure text matches.

tool_signatures.name: mason_init
tool_signatures.description: Inspect this project now: returns documentation audit findings, committed-diff review findings, decision/map status, and a quickstart playbook. Quickstart is read-only and deterministic. Explicit mode: init prepares shared MCP, instructions and hooks for review and commit; setup activates compatible existing configuration locally without shared edits. Neither runs audits or prepares repairs; use only when requested. Optional host selects codex or claude. Optional base selects the review comparison; evidence imports CI manifests with check outcomes, commit freshness, and links to changed files and accepted decisions. Repeat calls refresh findings even after setup.

tool_signatures.name: review_decision
tool_signatures.description: Prepare a decision review: returns the full record and history, any operative accepted revision, provenance, changes and previews for both sets of anchors, and a reviewToken. For accepted-guidance inspection use inspectionScope operative on both prepare and inspect; pending proposals remain unassessed. Default all scope covers both revisions. After source inspection, record inspect with inspector, note and token to report no contradiction found without human acceptance. For human review, prepare with all scope, then record accept, reaffirm, or retire with its token, the authorized reviewer, and a reason. Acceptance replaces the operative revision; retirement withdraws the entire record including its proposal. Acceptance requires owner, source, readable Git HEAD, and committed anchor changes. Changed records or code invalidate the token. Identities and approvals are recorded assertions for normal PR review, not authenticated proof.

id.description: Decision id from get_context or save_decision

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

note.description: Review rationale; required for a verdict. Cite evidence for the decision.

inspector.description: Actual agent or person performing inspection; required for inspect. Does not claim human approval.

reviewToken.description: Token from the prepared review; rejects stale record or code revisions

inspectionScope.description: For prepare/inspect only: all covers the full record and both anchor sets (default); operative covers only an active accepted revision, leaving a pending draft unassessed. Use the same scope when submitting its token.

tool_signatures.name: save_decision
tool_signatures.description: Capture or revise a decision proposal as soon as the lesson is supported by evidence, without waiting for implementation or merge. Keep unimplemented remedies tentative. Include rationale, anchors, optional owner, sources, and a known actor. Compare matching get_context records and pending proposals before saving. When new evidence changes the same lesson's assumptions, scope, or recommended action, pass its existing id, including for accepted records. Preserve supported rationale and sources and replace obsolete instructions. Create a new record for a genuinely distinct lesson; skip unchanged restatements. No setup or map required. Writes a local record and preserves content history. Changes create a pending proposal while the last accepted revision remains operative; unchanged content does not re-verify or refresh it. Use review_decision for authorized acceptance or reaffirmation. A proposal cannot supersede a record with an operative accepted revision; review its replacement and retire the original separately.

id.description: Pass the matching record's existing id when evidence changes that lesson's assumptions, scope, or recommended action, including for accepted records. Changed content becomes a proposal while the accepted version remains operative; unchanged content leaves review and freshness untouched.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

body.description: The knowledge itself: what was tried/decided, why, and what to avoid. Must contain information NOT derivable by reading the code. Aim for 1500 characters or fewer; up to 2500 is accepted with a warning above the target. Matching context and hooks include the full body. Preserve exceptions; use sources for supporting references.

actor.description: Known person or agent recording this revision; omit when unknown

files.description: Repo-relative files or directory prefixes; changes flag the decision for re-verification across retrieval, hooks, and review

force.description: Save even when a near-duplicate was detected

owner.description: Responsible person or team; null clears it. Required for acceptance.

title.description: Short, specific headline (max 80 characters). Generates a stable id on creation; revising the title keeps the existing id.

sources.description: Known source references; omit to preserve, [] clears

supersedes.description: Id of an unreviewed record or proposal with no accepted revision to replace. Operative accepted decisions require separate review and retirement.
